This vignette outlines the workflow and statistical methods implemented in
`sapid` (Strategy to Analyze Plant Extracts Taste in Depth).

## Installation

```r
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
install.packages(
  "sapid",
  repos = c(
    "https://adafede.r-universe.dev",
    "https://taxonomicallyinformedannotation.r-universe.dev",
    BiocManager::repositories(),
    "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```

## Workflow overview

1. **Vocabulary harmonization & panel scaling**:
   - `harmonize_terms()` and `harmonize_terms_df()` standardize free-text French
     panelist terms using length-ordered two-pass sentinel token replacement
     (`\x01<idx>\x02`) so shorter patterns never overwrite already-translated
     substrings.
   - `prepare_profiles()` corrects FIZZ `> 10` scale export artifacts prior to
     deduplication and aggregates synonymous ratings per panelist and sample via
     `max(value, na.rm = TRUE)`.
   - `load_consistent_profiles()` retains descriptors used by at least
     `min_jury` distinct panelists and optionally applies multiplicative
     root-mean-square (RMS) juror scaling (`normalize_panelists = TRUE`).
2. **Psychophysics & sensory evaluation**:
   - `plot_concentration()` fits a guessing-corrected 3-AFC binomial
     log-logistic psychometric model
     ($P(c) = \gamma + (1 - \gamma)\Lambda(\beta(\log_{10} c - \mu))$ with
     $\gamma = 1/3$) to estimate the 50% true detection threshold
     ($\text{EC}_{50}$ at $P = 2/3$) and delta-method 95% confidence ribbons.
   - `plot_chasselas_modulation()` evaluates paired before/after wine modulation
     using Pratt's (1959) zero-preserving Wilcoxon signed-rank test
     (`test_method = "pratt"`).
   - `plot_informed_tasting()` compares classical raw-extract tasting against
     gravimetrically reconstituted fraction tasting using harmonized
     panelist-normalized intensities.
   - `plot_napping()` performs Procrustes MFA (`SensoMineR::pmfa()`), MFA with
     descriptor word contingencies as a supplementary block
     (`FactoMineR::MFA()`), and Ward's hierarchical clustering
     (`FactoMineR::HCPC(method = "ward")`).
   - `plot_descriptors_network()` builds a simple weighted directed graph of
     sample fractions, original panelist terms, and harmonized descriptors.
3. **1D proton NMR & LC-MS/CAD correlation**:
   - `cluster_nmr()` excludes solvent regions prior to total-area normalization,
     merges detected peak positions within `peak_width_ppm / 2`, and clusters
     fractions using Hellinger distance (`dist_method = "euclidean"` on
     square-root areas) with `ward.D2` linkage.
   - `correlate_ion_taste_intensities()` and `plot_correlations()` compute
     rolling-window correlations across contiguous fractions, map Kendall's
     $\tau$ onto the Pearson-equivalent scale via Greiner's relation
     $r_{\text{eq}} = \sin(\frac{\pi}{2}\tau)$, deduplicate co-eluting 2D
     InChIKeys within local retention-time windows (`rt_window = 0.5` min) to
     preserve chromatographic isomers, and rank candidates via a
     sample-size-adjusted Fisher-$z$ desirability score.
